snippet.title: Kingdom Two Crowns: Pharaoh Lands - DLC Reveal Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Kingdom Two Crowns: Pharaoh Lands: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4742120/Kingdom_Two_Crowns_Pharaoh_Lands/

Beneath a scorching sun, a vista of rolling dunes with massive pyramid monuments rising towards the sky reveals itself. Set out in valley of kings and a domain of powerful gods in an ancient Egypt-inspired setting. Coming 2026! 

Kingdom Two Crowns: Pharaoh Lands Store Pages:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4742120/Kingdom_Two_Crowns_Pharaoh_Lands/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP2320-CUSA13597_00-KINGDOMTWOCROWNS
XBOX: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/kingdom-two-crowns/bwt2gpvwch2f
Nintendo: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/kingdom-two-crowns-switch/

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!
